name: Gacha Forge
description: A complete gacha game mode. Describe a world and Gacha Forge builds the rest: banners to pull on, a cast the model writes and paints for you, story chapters told by a visual-novel narrator, and the battles, gear and events that grow around them. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Gacha Forge.
author: SonaGate
